purpose: Disagreement-gated outer weight. When the v9 side (v9 + residual stage) and the fold side (committee mix at share 0.75) disagree strongly, lean toward the HIGHER side instead of the fixed scope weight: a model that sees a delay signal is usually right, since taxi times run long but rarely much below the unimpeded time. The label-free audit (tools/disagreement_audit.py, docs/disagreement/audit.json) finds January 2026 far outside the development months: |D| > 600 s on 0.55% of rows (0.10-0.26% in 2025), 408 unmatched non-LIRF rows with D > 600 (173 in all four development months together), concentrated at EHAM on 3-7 January 2026 (disruption; 29.9% of EHAM unmatched rows). Fair development rows only; no model is fitted.

prior_context.note: Declared AFTER an exploratory screen on the fair rows (least-squares weight on the fold side and RMSE of each side per D bin, pooled over the four months and per month for D > 600); disclosed here. The per-month candidate scores below were NOT computed before this declaration. Scopes and signs were chosen from that screen.
prior_context.screen_lirf_nonpop_matched: D = LIRF column - v9. D 300-600: 575 rows, LS weight on the column 1.11; 600-1200: 121, 1.33 (v34 uses 0.85).
prior_context.dev_analog: EHAM 5 January 2025 (snow): 44 unmatched rows, mean label 1731 s, fold side 1408, v9 side 1092.
prior_context.ranking_eham_crosscheck: EHAM gate-matched rows on 3-7 January 2026: v9 tracks the ADS-B motion-to-takeoff (docs/error_map); unmatched rows on those days have v9 1438-1783 s against fold side 2004-2718 s.

control: v34: v33 exactly as in configs/fair_weights_v1.json with the lirf_nonpop_unmatched v9 share 0 (configs/fair_lirf_v1.json lu00); the v33 rebuild must equal rows.parquet's v33 to 1e-9 s per row first

definitions.D_non_lirf: mix - base (base = v9 + residual stage on matched_no_lirf rows, mix = committee mix at share 0.75)
definitions.D_lirf_matched: (0.40 * lirf_net + 0.45 * lirf_tree) / 0.85 - v9 on lirf_nonpop_matched rows
definitions.unm: non-LIRF, non-LTFM rows without an ADS-B match (control weight 0.7)

candidate_semantics: unm_up T: unm rows with D > T get outer weight 1.0 (value = max(mix, floor)); mat_down T: mat rows with D < -T get outer weight 0.0 (value = max(base, floor)); lirf_up T: lirf_m rows with D_lirf > T get v9 share 0 (value = max(column, floor)); every other row keeps the control
selection: Unchanged rule: eligible when no recipe month is worse on ALL rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1, and every touched month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; lowest mean ratio among eligible; otherwise keep v34. December (equal footing) is reported separately.
ship: delta = gated recipe minus v34's recipe on the final-file dry-run detail (D from the ranking's twelve-month components), added to v34's floats, floored at -12 s; independent rebuild; audit; upload only on the user's decision.
